propositions.name: aether_fills_empty_space
propositions.statement: The aether is a material substance more subtle than visible bodies that exists in those parts of space which are apparently empty.
propositions.quote: a material substance of a more subtle kind than visible bodies, supposed to exist in those parts of space which are apparently empty

propositions.name: luminiferous_aether_evidence
propositions.statement: Evidence for the existence of the luminiferous aether has accumulated as additional phenomena of light and other radiations have been discovered.
propositions.quote: The evidence for the existence of the luminiferous aether has accumulated as additional phenomena of light and other radiations have been discovered

propositions.name: aether_properties_match_electromagnetism
propositions.statement: The properties of the aether, as deduced from the phenomena of light, are precisely those required to explain electromagnetic phenomena.
propositions.quote: the properties of this medium, as deduced from the phenomena of light, have been found to be precisely those required to explain electromagnetic phenomena

propositions.name: light_is_not_a_substance
propositions.statement: Light cannot be a substance because two bodies put together cannot annihilate each other.
propositions.quote: we cannot suppose that two bodies when put together can annihilate each other; therefore light cannot be a substance

propositions.name: light_is_a_process
propositions.statement: Light is not a substance but a process going on in a substance.
propositions.quote: We therefore conclude that light is not a substance but a process going on in a substance

propositions.name: interference_destroys_light
propositions.statement: Two portions of light can destroy each other so that the screen becomes dark.
propositions.quote: the screen in certain places becomes dark, and thus shows that the two portions of light have destroyed each other.

propositions.name: extinction_at_half_wavelength
propositions.statement: Light is extinguished when the difference of the length of the paths is an odd multiple of a half wave-length.
propositions.quote: the light is extinguished when the difference of the length of the paths is an odd multiple of a certain small distance called a half wave-length

propositions.name: finite_velocity_of_light
propositions.statement: Light is propagated with a certain finite velocity in vacuum.
propositions.quote: light is known to be propagated with a certain velocity (3.004 x 10 centimetres per second in vacuum, according to Cornu)

propositions.name: vibration_amplitude_period_phase
propositions.statement: The process going on at a fixed point in a beam of light is called a vibration and is characterized by an amplitude, a period, and a phase.
propositions.quote: is called a vibration ; the constant A is called the amplitude ; the time 2π/n is called the period ; and nt — px + a is the phase.

propositions.name: wave_and_wave_length_defined
propositions.statement: The configuration of the process at a given instant is called a wave, and the distance of the wave is called the wave-length.
propositions.quote: The configuration at a given instant is called a wave , and the distance 2 π / P is called the wave-length .

propositions.name: light_process_is_transverse_vector
propositions.statement: The physical process involved in the propagation of light is a directed vector at right angles to the ray.
propositions.quote: the physical process involved in the propagation of light must not only be a directed quantity or vector capable of having its direction reversed, but this vector must be at right angles to the ray

propositions.name: electric_magnetic_perpendicular
propositions.statement: In the electromagnetic process, the electric displacement and the magnetic disturbance are perpendicular to each other.
propositions.quote: in this case the electric displacement and the magnetic disturbance are perpendicular to each other

propositions.name: nonvisible_radiations_show_interference
propositions.statement: Radiations which do not produce a luminous impression on our eyes also show the phenomena of interference and have measurable wave-lengths.
propositions.quote: the phenomena of interference have been observed, and the wave-lengths measured, in the case of radiations, which can be detected only by their heating or by their chemical effects

propositions.name: aether_transmits_energy
propositions.statement: The aether is capable of transmitting energy, and the radiations it transmits act on our senses.
propositions.quote: In the first place, it is capable of transmitting energy. The radiations which it transmits are able not only to act on our senses

propositions.name: energy_takes_time_in_medium
propositions.statement: Energy is not transmitted instantaneously from the radiating body to the absorbing body but exists for a certain time in the medium.
propositions.quote: this energy is not transmitted instantaneously from the radiating body to the absorbing body, but exists for a certain time in the medium

propositions.name: aether_elastic_and_finite_density
propositions.statement: The aether possesses elasticity similar to that of a solid body and has a finite density.
propositions.quote: We must therefore regard the aether as possessing elasticity similar to that of a solid body, and also as having a finite density.

propositions.name: energy_half_potential_half_kinetic
propositions.statement: Half of the energy in the medium is potential energy due to distortion of portions of the medium, and half is kinetic energy due to motion of the medium.
propositions.quote: half of this energy is in the form of potential energy, due to the distortion of elementary portions of the medium, and half in the form of kinetic energy, due to the motion of the medium

propositions.name: aether_denser_than_atmosphere
propositions.statement: In interplanetary space the density of the aether is very great compared with the attenuated atmosphere of interplanetary space.
propositions.quote: the density of the aether is therefore very great compared with that of the attenuated atmosphere of interplanetary space

propositions.name: aether_mass_small_versus_planets
propositions.statement: The whole mass of aether within a sphere whose radius is that of the most distant planet is very small compared with that of the planets themselves.
propositions.quote: the whole mass of aether within a sphere whose radius is that of the most distant planet is very small compared with that of the planets themselves.

propositions.name: air_is_not_the_medium
propositions.statement: The medium through which light is propagated is not the air itself, because air cannot transmit transverse vibrations.
propositions.quote: the medium through which the light is propagated is not the air itself, for in the first place the air cannot transmit transverse vibrations

propositions.name: aether_interpenetrates_bodies
propositions.statement: The medium through which light is propagated is distinct from the transparent medium known to us, and it interpenetrates all transparent bodies and probably opaque bodies too.
propositions.quote: the medium through which light is propagated is something distinct from the transparent medium known to us, though it interpenetrates all transparent bodies and probably opaque bodies too.

propositions.name: velocity_varies_by_medium
propositions.statement: The velocity of light is different in different transparent media.
propositions.quote: The velocity of light, however, is different in different transparent media

propositions.name: matter_particles_vibrate_too
propositions.statement: The particles of transparent media are vibrating as well as those of the aether.
propositions.quote: these media take some part in the process, and that their particles are vibrating as well as those of the aether

propositions.name: aether_ocean_bodies_move_through
propositions.statement: Dense bodies move through a great ocean of aether, and whether they carry the aether along with them or whether the aether passes through them is a question.
propositions.quote: when these dense bodies are in motion through the great ocean of aether, they carry along with them the aether they contain, or whether the aether passes through them

propositions.name: fizeau_water_carries_light
propositions.statement: The propagation of light in a stream of water takes place with greater velocity in the direction in which the water moves than in the opposite direction.
propositions.quote: the propagation of light in a stream of water takes place with greater velocity in the direction in which the water moves than in the opposite direction

propositions.name: aether_agent_of_electromagnetism
propositions.statement: The same medium which is concerned in the propagation of light is also the agent in electromagnetic phenomena.
propositions.quote: the same medium which is concerned in the propagation of light might also be the agent in electromagnetic phenomena

propositions.name: electric_displacement_elicits_force
propositions.statement: An electric displacement in the medium elicits an electromotive force in the opposite direction.
propositions.quote: an electric displacement elicits an electromotive force in the opposite direction, the electromotive force for unit displacement being inversely as the specific inductive capacity of the medium

propositions.name: electrokinetic_energy_is_medium_motion
propositions.statement: Electrokinetic energy is the energy of the motion set up in the medium by electric currents and magnets.
propositions.quote: The electrokinetic energy, on the other hand, is simply the energy of the motion set up in the medium by electric currents and magnets

propositions.name: electromagnetic_and_luminiferous_media_identical
propositions.statement: If the velocity of an electromagnetic disturbance is equal to the velocity of light, the electromagnetic medium and the luminiferous medium, occupying the same space, are really identical.
propositions.quote: If this should be equal to the velocity of light, we would have strong reason to believe that the two media, occupying as they do the same space, are really identical.

propositions.name: inductive_capacity_equals_refraction_square
propositions.statement: In non-magnetic media the specific inductive capacity should be equal to the square of the index of refraction.
propositions.quote: in non-magnetic media the specific inductive capacity should be equal to the square of the index of refraction

propositions.name: gases_confirm_inductive_capacity_relation
propositions.statement: The relation between specific inductive capacity and the square of the index of refraction is accurately true for the gases examined.
propositions.quote: Boltzmann has found that this is very accurately true for the gases which he has examined

propositions.name: aether_is_incompressible
propositions.statement: The aether must be assumed to be incompressible to account for the fact that the optical phenomena of normal vibrations do not take place.
propositions.quote: The only way of accounting for the fact that the optical phenomena which would arise from these waves do not take place is to assume that the aether is incompressible.

propositions.name: no_normal_displacement_in_em_theory
propositions.statement: In the electromagnetic theory of light no normal displacement can exist, and the specific dielectric capacity for each principal axis is assumed to be equal to the square of the index of refraction.
propositions.quote: No normal displacement can exist, and in doubly refracting crystals the specific dielectric capacity for each principal axis is assumed to be equal to the square of the index of refraction

propositions.name: aether_transmits_without_loss
propositions.statement: The aether transmits transverse vibrations to very great distances without sensible loss of energy by dissipation.
propositions.quote: We know that the aether transmits transverse vibrations to very great distances without sensible loss of energy by dissipation.

propositions.name: aether_not_gas_like
propositions.statement: The constitution of the aether cannot be like that of a gas in which the molecules are always in a state of irregular agitation.
propositions.quote: We cannot therefore suppose the constitution of the aether to be like that of a gas, in which the molecules are always in a state of irregular agitation

propositions.name: aether_probably_molecular
propositions.statement: The aether, as the medium of electromagnetic phenomena, is probably molecular.
propositions.quote: The ather, if it is the medium of electromagnetic phenomena, is probably molecular, at least in this sense.

propositions.name: magnetization_causes_rotation
propositions.statement: The magnetic influence on light depends on the direction of motion of moving particles and indicates a rotational motion in the medium when magnetized.
propositions.quote: the magnetic influence on light discovered by Faraday depends on the direction of motion of moving particles, and that it indicates a rotational motion in the medium when magnetized

propositions.name: medium_broken_into_vortices
propositions.statement: The medium must be broken up into a number of molecular vortices.
propositions.quote: the medium must be broken up into a number of molecular vortices

propositions.name: vortices_persist_without_dissipation
propositions.statement: The molecular vortices do not require a continual expenditure of work to maintain their motion, so this motion does not necessarily involve dissipation of energy.
propositions.quote: the molecular vortices do not require a continual expenditure of work in order to maintain their motion, and that therefore this motion does not necessarily involve dissipation of energy.

propositions.name: interplanetary_space_not_empty
propositions.statement: The interplanetary and interstellar spaces are not empty but are occupied by a material substance or body.
propositions.quote: there can be no doubt that the interplanetary and interstellar spaces are not empty, but are occupied by a material substance or body, which is certainly the largest
